assay: C57BL/6 mice, 20 mg/kg IV, AST/ALT at 96 h
chemistry: 3-8-3 LNA gapmers, fully phosphorothioate, recovered from the font colour of Table S1 and uniform across all 149
label: hepatotoxic if ALT > 100.0 U/L
caveat: 5 positive sequences. Too few to validate the endpoint; the confidence interval spans most of the range. Reported so the endpoint has some external signal, not as evidence of performance. These are 14-mer 3-8-3 LNA gapmers; the training corpus holds 12 LNA gapmer sequences and 369 MOE gapmers, so this is a chemistry it has barely seen.
